items.android.title: VpnHood! CONNECT - Secure VPN
items.android.short_description: Fast, secure, unlimited and open-source VPN
items.android.full_description:
VpnHood! CONNECT is a Fast, high-speed, and secure networking solution designed to prioritize your digital privacy. Powered by the open-source VpnHood ENGINE, it provides a reliable connection with unlimited bandwidth and no time restrictions.

🛡️ Key Features
Free to Use: Open access to secure networking. Please note that our free servers are not available in China or Russia.

User-Friendly: Connect with a single tap.

High Performance: Optimized for speed with unlimited data.

Open Source & Transparent: Built on the VpnHood engine (available on GitHub), ensuring a trustworthy and verifiable codebase.

Broad Compatibility: Supports Android 7+, Android TV, and Windows.

Dual-Stack Support: Full compatibility with both IPv4 and IPv6.

⚙️ Advanced Customization
App-Level Split Tunneling: Select specific apps to route through the secure tunnel or exclude them to optimize performance.

Geographic Filtering: Exclude local country traffic to maintain high-speed access to regional services and banking apps that require a local IP.

LAN Exclusion: Maintain access to local network resources (like printers or local servers) while staying protected online.

Protocol Control: Toggle between UDP and TCP protocols based on your specific network environment.

💡 Why Choose VpnHood!?
Privacy-First Protocol: VpnHood uses a sophisticated, fingerprint-resistant protocol. By mimicking standard HTTPS traffic patterns, it ensures your connection remains private and secure against deep packet inspection.

Innovative Core: As a pioneer in .NET-based VPN development, VpnHood offers a modern and robust architecture.

Security Audited: For your peace of mind, VpnHood has undergone a comprehensive security audit by the Open Tech Fund.

Community Driven: We are committed to continuous improvement, ensuring our technology evolves alongside modern networking standards to provide an unrestricted internet experience.

🌍 Server Availability
Our free servers are available in most countries. They are currently not available in China or Russia.

📞 24/7 Support
Our dedicated team is here to help you at any time. For questions or technical assistance, reach out to us:
📧 Email: support@vpnhood.com
